methodology: Articles sourced from Virginia-specific RSS feeds and Google News RSS, filtered for AI/technology/workforce relevance, then assessed by Claude against the scenario framework. Each article is tagged with the region it most affects and the scenario it signals toward.

signals.title: Roanoke College launches AI training program for workplace professionals - WDBJ7
signals.signal_reading: Roanoke College's workplace AI training program represents distributed capacity-building outside metro hubs, creating pathways for deep fluency through peer networks in traditionally underserved regions—a classic Build It Yourself signal if it scales beyond single institutions.

signals.title: Roanoke College launches WorkAI Lab to prepare leaders for new era of technology - Roanoke College
signals.signal_reading: The WorkAI Lab positions a regional college as an AI fluency hub for workplace leaders, potentially seeding distributed expertise networks across Southwest Virginia if graduates return to local organizations rather than migrating to NoVA.

signals.title: New partnership between VCU and AI Ready RVA aims to boost AI education, innovation and community impact - VCU News
signals.signal_reading: VCU's AI Ready RVA partnership concentrates research-grade AI capability in the capital region, reinforcing Richmond's emergence as a secondary excellence pocket but doing little to bridge the rural-metro capability divide without intentional distribution mechanisms.

signals.title: Digital Realty Acquires $7.8 bn Northern Virginia Data Center Portfolio from Blackstone to Expand AI Infrastructure - InfotechLead
signals.signal_reading: A $7.8 billion data center acquisition deepens NoVA's infrastructure dominance for AI workloads, but infrastructure concentration without workforce distribution signals Pockets of Excellence—physical compute power doesn't automatically translate to distributed human capability.

signals.title: State invests $3M to help transform Hampton Roads into hub for aircraft technology and training - 13newsnow.com
signals.signal_reading: State investment targeting Hampton Roads as an aircraft technology hub suggests intentional diversification of advanced tech capacity beyond NoVA, but the defense-industrial focus may create another excellence pocket rather than truly distributed AI fluency across workforce sectors.
